title: Predicting Linear Relational Decodability Without the Relation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27241v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear relational embeddings (LREs) approximate a language model's subject-to-object mapping with an affine function. Their faithfulness varies enormously across relations, from near zero for person_father to the ceiling for country_capital_city. We investigate the factors that contribute to this variation and demonstrate that it can be significantly predicted from a readout that is not aware of the underlying relation. To do so, we propose a novel form of the Jacobian lens, the entity lens. Whereas the Jacobian lens is estimated across all tokens and concepts, the entity lens EL_t is trained to predict what the model will output for an entity of type t under the neutral prompt "{} is known for"; e.g., we train ELs for countries and persons. translated_title: 无需关系信息即可预测线性关系可解码性
translated_abstract: 线性关系嵌入（Linear Relational Embeddings, LREs）使用仿射函数来近似语言模型从主体到客体的映射。其忠实度在不同关系之间差异巨大：例如 person_father（某人的父亲）关系的忠实度接近于零，而 country_capital_city（国家首都城市）关系则达到上限。我们研究了导致这种差异的因素，并证明这种差异可以从一个不了解底层关系的读出（readout）中被显著预测出来。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的雅可比透镜（Jacobian lens）形式——实体透镜（entity lens）。雅可比透镜是在所有词元和概念上进行估计的，而实体透镜 EL_t 则被训练用于预测模型在中性提示词"{} is known for"（“{} 以……闻名”）下对类型为 t 的实体会输出什么；例如，我们分别为国家和人物类型训练了实体透镜。在估计出实体透镜之后，我们测量它在多大程度上将模型对某个关系的答案排在高位，而在整个估计和预测过程中不使用任何关系特定的信息。在28个关系……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“实体透镜”这一新颖的雅可比透镜变体，通过在与关系无关的中性提示下针对实体类型进行训练，能够在不使用任何关系特定信息的情况下，显著预测线性关系嵌入（LRE）在不同关系上忠实度的巨大差异。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the "entity lens," a novel variant of the Jacobian lens trained on entity types under a relation-neutral prompt, which can predict—without using any relation-specific information—the large variation in faithfulness of linear relational embeddings (LREs) across different relations.
